notes: HAND-MAINTAINED, county-level (Collin runs countywide vote centers, so this is boundary-independent). Update each election cycle. Dates below are the statutory Texas windows confirmed against the SOS election calendar (sos.state.tx.us/elections/voter/important-election-dates.shtml) — registrationDeadline is the 30th day before election day, moved to the next business day when it falls on a weekend (Oct 4, 2026 is a Sunday, so Monday Oct 5). electionDayHours is statutory (Tex. Elec. Code 41.031); early-voting hours vary by location and day, so they are deliberately NOT listed — the app points voters at the county site instead. voterId is the statutory list (Tex. Elec. Code 63.0101) and only changes if the law does. Vote centers: add entries with verified name/address; include lat/lng ONLY when the coordinates are verified — entries without lat/lng still list on the handout, just without a distance. Never guess a date or coordinate: the app renders honest fallbacks (vote411.org) for anything missing.

accepted: U.S. military ID card with your photo
U.S. citizenship certificate with your photo
voterId.expirationNote: The ID can be expired up to 4 years. If you're 70 or older, it can be expired any amount of time.
voterId.noIdNote: No photo ID? You can still vote: sign a short form at the polls (a Reasonable Impediment Declaration) and show a document with your name and address — like a voter registration certificate, utility bill, bank statement, paycheck, or government check.
